# Bored Panda

> Bored Panda is a leading global content publisher, entertaining millions of readers every day by feeding their curiosity with human-curated stories.

## Prime Verticals

- [Funny](https://www.boredpanda.com/funny/): Internet humor, curated memes, comedic social threads, and trending viral fails.
- [Relationships](https://www.boredpanda.com/relationships/): Heartwarming, relatable, and dramatic stories covering dating, marriage, and family life.
- [Animals](https://www.boredpanda.com/animals/): Highly shareable wildlife features, funny pet compilations, and heartwarming animal narratives.
- [Curiosities](https://www.boredpanda.com/curiosities/): Fascinating trivia, mind-blowing facts, unusual history, and weird phenomenons from around the world.
- [Entertainment](https://www.boredpanda.com/entertainment/): Pop-culture updates, celebrity drama, movie/TV trends, and internet subculture news.

## Creator Community & Corporate

- [About Bored Panda](https://www.boredpanda.com/about-us/): Our global mission, editorial philosophy, and team.
- [Advertise with Us](https://www.boredpanda.com/advertise/): US & Global media kit, traffic metrics, and custom brand partnership options.
- [Contact Editorial](https://www.boredpanda.com/contact/): Media inquiries, story pitches, and official support.
